Question: Which of the following statements about regular polygons is correct?

Choices.A: The apothem of a regular polygon equals its circumradius.
Choices.B: The circumcircle and incircle of a regular polygon are concentric.
Choices.C: The central angle of a regular polygon equals its interior angle.

Solution: The circumcircle and incircle of a regular polygon have the same center (the center of the regular polygon). The apothem is less than the radius. The central angle is \(360^\circ/n\), which differs from the interior angle.
